title: 232. Minimum Path Sum

examples.explanation: Because the path 1 -> 3 -> 1 -> 1 -> 1 minimizes the sum.

hints: Use dynamic programming. dp[i][j] is the minimum sum reaching (i, j), computed as grid[i][j] plus the smaller of the sums from above and left.
Initialize the first row and first column cumulatively since only one move direction is available along the borders.
